proposal.reason: Primary change is communicator config lifecycle: new communicator settings are validated, defaulted, env-overridden, stored, and synchronized across ranks. Additional device-topology review is needed because P2P channel counts are now computed from remote network-path bandwidth and constrained by maxP2pPeers in topology/channel computation. Additional enqueue review is needed because graph-usage mode now changes strong-stream capture/mixing behavior across enqueue/channel/transport call paths, and a prior P2P channel-overload scheduling cap was removed in runtime planning.
